lead.t: A pituitary disorder is any condition that impairs the normal structure or function of the pituitary gland, leading to excess or deficiency of one or more pituitary hormones.

snip.t: A pituitary disorder is any condition that impairs the normal structure or function of the pituitary gland, leading to excess or deficiency of one or more pituitary hormones.
*After reading this note you will be able to recognise, investigate and outline the acute and definitive management of common pituitary disorders seen in Kenyan clinical rotations.
Pituitary disorders include hyperpituitarism (e.g., adenomas causing hormone excess or mass effects) and hypopituitarism (deficiency of pituitary hormones).

qs.q: Which pituitary disorder is characterized by excessive secretion of ACTH, leading to hypercortisolism, central obesity, and a moon face?
qs.e: Cushing's Disease is caused by excessive secretion of ACTH from a pituitary adenoma, which overstimulates the adrenal glands to produce excess cortisol. Hyperprolactinemia involves excess prolactin leading to galactorrhea rather than hypercortisolism.
